## One-click setup
1. Click **Publish / Activate** (top right).
2. Open the **Open setup page** node and copy its **Production URL**.
3. Open that URL in your browser and follow the steps.

Keys you paste are used once to create n8n credentials and are never stored by this workflow. Execution saving is off for this workflow, so they never appear in your execution logs. When setup finishes, this workflow switches itself off.
